How it works

From idea to finished website in 3 days.

One contact person, a clear plan and a team that delivers fast.

  1. Day 1

    Briefing & draft

    You tell us what you need. We secure your domain and show you a first draft.

  2. Day 2

    Build

    Our team builds your website with all pages and features and sets up email and payments.

  3. Day 3

    Polish & launch

    We make your requested changes, test everything on all devices and put your website live.

The 3 days start from our conversation once your texts, logo and images are available. If content is missing, we help you write it. Larger shops or custom features are planned together, with a firm schedule agreed in advance.

Your part

  • Send texts, logo and images if you have them

FAQ

Good to know.

Do I have to set up or learn anything?

No. You get a finished website with domain and email. If you like, we make changes for you.

Who owns the domain and the website?

You do. The domain is registered in your name, and you receive all access details.

What does my website cost?

After a short conversation you receive a clear offer. We tell you running costs such as domain and email upfront, with no hidden fees.

How do online payments work?

We set up an established payment provider and connect it to your website. You only confirm your company details there once, as required by law.

Can my website grow later?

Yes. New pages, more languages, a shop or additional automation can be added at any time.

What about the legal notice and privacy policy?

We integrate the legal notice, privacy policy and cookie banner technically. The legal texts come from you or a legal-text provider of your choice; we do not provide legal advice.

Tell us what you need.

A short message is enough: what do you offer, what should the website do, do you already have a domain? We get back to you with a proposal and a clear offer.
